# Project rules
This repository is an Agentic Scrum workshop kit. The case to build is described in CASE.md. Read it before you plan or build.

- Plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript only. No framework, no npm, no build step, no server, no API keys.
- The app lives in app/ and must work when app/index.html is opened by double-click.
- Use classic script tags. No ES modules and no fetch() for local files, because browsers block both on a page opened from disk.
- Load data from data/ with script tags. Use no external library unless CASE.md allows it.
- Fictional data only. Never invent figures for real companies or people. An unknown value is null and shows as "n/a".
- One story per session. Keep changes small and touch only the files the story names.
- AI usage is read with /usage in the GitHub Copilot app. Never estimate AI credits and never treat a prompt count as a cost.
